form.label: Cloudflare Security and Access - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed overview for Cloudflare Logpush and Zero Trust JSON relay events. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures plus Splunk JSON/search-time knowledge; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=netwaf sourcetype IN ("cloudflare:http:request","cloudflare:waf:event","cloudflare:access:request","cloudflare:gateway:dns","cloudflare:gateway:http","cloudflare:gateway:network","cloudflare:audit") host=$host_tok$ | stats count

index=netwaf sourcetype IN ("cloudflare:waf:event","cloudflare:gateway:dns","cloudflare:gateway:http","cloudflare:gateway:network") host=$host_tok$ action IN ("block","blocked","isolate") | stats count
index=netwaf sourcetype IN ("cloudflare:access:request","cloudflare:audit") host=$host_tok$ | stats count

panel.title: Events over time by Cloudflare family

search.query: index=netwaf sourcetype IN ("cloudflare:http:request","cloudflare:waf:event","cloudflare:access:request","cloudflare:gateway:dns","cloudflare:gateway:http","cloudflare:gateway:network","cloudflare:audit") host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(cloudflare_family, sourcetype) | timechart count by family

index=netwaf sourcetype IN ("cloudflare:http:request","cloudflare:waf:event","cloudflare:access:request","cloudflare:gateway:dns","cloudflare:gateway:http","cloudflare:gateway:network","cloudflare:audit") host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(cloudflare_family, sourcetype) | stats count by family | sort -count

index=netwaf sourcetype IN ("cloudflare:http:request","cloudflare:waf:event","cloudflare:access:request","cloudflare:gateway:dns","cloudflare:gateway:http","cloudflare:gateway:network","cloudflare:audit") host=$host_tok$ | eval cf_action=coalesce(action, SecurityAction, ResolverDecision) | stats count by cf_action | sort -count | head 20

index=netwaf sourcetype IN ("cloudflare:access:request","cloudflare:gateway:dns","cloudflare:gateway:http","cloudflare:gateway:network","cloudflare:audit") host=$host_tok$ | eval cf_user=coalesce(user, UserEmail, Email, ActorEmail) | stats count by cf_user | sort -count | head 20

index=netwaf sourcetype IN ("cloudflare:http:request","cloudflare:waf:event","cloudflare:access:request","cloudflare:gateway:dns","cloudflare:gateway:http","cloudflare:gateway:network","cloudflare:audit") host=$host_tok$ | eval cf_src_ip=coalesce(src_ip, ClientIP, SourceIP, IPAddress, ActorIP) | stats count by cf_src_ip | sort -count | head 20
index=netwaf sourcetype="cloudflare:waf:event" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host action src_ip dest uri http_method rule_id rule_message ruleset_id ray_id marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=netwaf sourcetype IN ("cloudflare:access:request","cloudflare:gateway:dns","cloudflare:gateway:http","cloudflare:gateway:network","cloudflare:audit") host=$host_tok$ | eval cf_target=coalesce(dest, url, query, sni, dest_ip, resource_name, resource_id) | table _time sourcetype host user src_ip src_port dest_ip dest_port transport action cf_target policy_id policy_name resource_type signature signature_id marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=netwaf sourcetype="cloudflare:gateway:network" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host user src_ip src_port src_internal_ip dest_ip dest_port sni transport app action policy_id policy_name session_id device_id marker | sort -_time | head 100

panel.title: HTTP request status and host coverage

search.query: index=netwaf sourcetype="cloudflare:http:request" host=$host_tok$ | stats count by dest uri http_method status cache_status action | sort -count | head 50

index=netwaf sourcetype IN ("cloudflare:http:request","cloudflare:waf:event","cloudflare:access:request","cloudflare:gateway:dns","cloudflare:gateway:http","cloudflare:gateway:network","cloudflare:audit") host=$host_tok$ | eval family=coalesce(cloudflare_family, sourcetype) | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host family | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

index=netwaf sourcetype IN ("cloudflare:http:request","cloudflare:waf:event","cloudflare:access:request","cloudflare:gateway:dns","cloudflare:gateway:http","cloudflare:gateway:network","cloudflare:audit") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype cloudflare_family ray_id user src_ip dest uri url http_method action signature signature_id rule_id policy_id session_id dest_ip dest_port transport resource_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 50
